description: Can I see the northern (or southern) lights from here right now? Returns the probability of aurora overhead at a latitude and longitude from the NOAA SWPC OVATION model, a 30-90 minute forecast, plus the best chance within 5 degrees poleward (aurora there can show on the horizon). Works worldwide. It does not account for daylight, cloud or moonlight, and is not a multi-day forecast. (cost: 1 credit)

lat.description: number, required, latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

lon.description: number, required, longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180, or 0 to 360)

name: aurora_chance_at_location
